kancamagus-highway.title: Kancamagus Highway
kancamagus-highway.slogan: Lincoln New Hampshire to Conway · one way

waypoints.name: Lincoln New Hampshire
waypoints.advice: Lincoln New Hampshire is where the day begins. Next is Kancamagus Pass.

waypoints.name: Kancamagus Pass
waypoints.advice: Kancamagus Pass comes up 32 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Sabbaday Falls, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Sabbaday Falls
waypoints.advice: 63 km in you reach Sabbaday Falls. Next is Conway.

waypoints.name: Conway
waypoints.advice: Conway closes the day.

sections.advice: Lincoln New Hampshire → Kancamagus Pass climbs about 863 m in 17 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Kancamagus Pass → Sabbaday Falls drops about 863 m over 12 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Sabbaday Falls → Conway is 27 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

kancamagus-highway.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Kancamagus Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Kancamagus Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 29 km. 863 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Kancamagus Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 863 m come off over 20 km at around 7.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Kancamagus Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 46 km this is Kancamagus Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

kancamagus-highway.story: Out of Woodstock, one way: 95 km, roughly 1 h 36 in the saddle. The stops in between: Kancamagus Pass and Sabbaday Falls. The highest point is about 850 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
